name: manual_7b260b
claim: Before the first push in a multi-remote worktree, run 'git remote -v' and confirm which remote name maps to the intended target repo -- never assume 'origin' is correct when a worktree was set up with multiple named remotes (e.g. 'origin' for a frozen v1 repo, 'oramasys' for the real v2 code repo).

decisions.notes: Self-caught near-miss 2026-09-07: pushed a oramasys/oramasys code fix (192.88.99.0/24 dialer prohibition) to 'origin' by reflexive 'git push -u origin <branch>', which resolved to diazMelgarejo/orama-system (the frozen v1 docs-only repo) instead of the 'oramasys' remote pointing at oramasys/oramasys. Caught before opening a PR; deleted the wrong branch and re-pushed to the correct remote. No v1 contamination occurred, but the regime boundary (v1 repos receive zero agent-merged code) was one PR-open away from being violated.
